summary: Umpqua NF, Douglas County, OR: 10-ft pole L-5 tower built 1933; register says removed in 1964, Fire Lookout site says destroyed; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 10-foot pole L-5 tower topped by a 10 x 10 Aladdin lookout house
facts.status_note: Register says the tower was removed in 1964; the Fire Lookout website says it was destroyed in 1964

events.note: 10-foot pole L-5 tower with a 10 x 10 Aladdin lookout house on a 10-foot round timber tower
Roseburg News-Review item (August 10, 1938) says Maurice Reid of Idleyld Park had spent the past few weeks on the Oak Flats lookout station
Register says the tower was removed in 1964
